result.summary: 4/14 tests passed (10 failed). All 10 failures share one root cause: sqlstate=42703 (undefined_column) on public.entity_definitions.tenant_id. Fix commit 3ced4800 (#823) left a WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid clause in src/entities/query/allowlist.zig:88-90 against the global-registry table public.entity_definitions, which has no tenant_id column (removed by migration GBL-123). Handler catches DbError and returns HTTP 503 instead of expected 200/400 for all tests that reach loadAllowlist. Passing tests: qry01_unknown_op (operator check fires before allowlist), qry04_denied, qry04_unknown, qry04_cross_tenant (all return emptyEnvelope before allowlist). Requires new WF-03 fix: remove or correct the tenant_id predicate in allowlist.zig.

issues.title: allowlist.zig loadAllowlist queries tenant_id on public.entity_definitions which has no such column (regression from commit 3ced4800 #823)
issues.description: public.entity_definitions has no tenant_id column (removed by migration GBL-123). WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid causes sqlstate=42703 for every call that reaches loadAllowlist. 10/14 QRY-01..04 tests fail with HTTP 503. Fix: remove tenant_id predicate (global registry uses name + status = ACTIVE) or route query to per-tenant shadow table (GBL-137).
